decisions.reason: The firm has invested in glass-silicon wafer technology since 2018 and remains publicly committed, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
Its dated launch announcement and continued mention show visible commitment that management will justify by persisting.
The dedicated webpage and SEMICON Europa launch represent the highest public commitment, making dropping very unlikely.
Founding the Wafer Universe brand is a visible strategic commitment that escalation of commitment leads management to maintain.
Though less prominently featured, the product still involves investment and a public launch, and weak results can be attributed to temporary market conditions.
